scope: Resume uninvestigated issues/areas first; rejected methods later. Checkpoints are scoped real-data evidence, not whole-app certification.
preflight: Inspect current diff/source and database object epochs; reconcile old evidence to the current shared owner.
Select one issue/area, actual cohort, expected behavior/resource question and stopping condition.
Use actual admin/catalogue data. Controlled private-copy state is allowed; label it and restore it. No fabricated catalogue/events/provider responses.
Document stateful GET/provider effects and required existing authorizations; do independent preparation before any new approval need.

newIssues.task: Trace the reproduced finalization/manual-enqueue lock cycle at native owners; retain original/candidate failure evidence, propose smallest lock-order fix, then verify concurrent schedule and ordinary effects on an actual-data copy.
Establish intended post-snapshot enqueue/Undo recovery behavior and reproduce at native owners on retained actual data; optimize only after the correctness contract is explicit.
Define the full feed ordering contract, then verify the reverted deterministic-input candidate through actual feed/provider callers and include extra sorting cost.

areas.task: Use the131-family source checklist to map each real route/selector to existing evidence, then run missing actual cases in bounded batches. Distinguish stateful GETs and provider calls before execution.
areas.acceptance: Exact applicable response/status/order/privacy contract plus per-owner actual SQL/resource evidence, explicit missing cohorts and source fingerprints.

areas.task: Refresh actual eligibility/active-job census; observe existing authorized jobs and compare claim/lease/retry/cancel semantics in a finite workload. Controlled real-admin state on a disposable actual copy is permitted when it exercises genuine native contracts; never fabricate provider replies or launch external imports merely for coverage.
areas.acceptance: Actual active-job lifecycle/ordering/checkpoint/lease/output correctness and resource measurements, with named side effects and independent cleanup.

areas.task: Capture a finite genuine connected-source paging trace at current source owners; separate legitimate partial/failure behavior and source order from the already adopted metadata/range binding.
areas.acceptance: Exact connection-scoped identity/order/total/page/failure behavior; no skipped intervals; preserve generation fences and account for committed observation writes.

areas.task: Select actual saved files and existing permitted sources; profile open/minimize/resume/close and genuine failure/recovery without changing tracking or account settings merely to create a case.
areas.acceptance: Correct content/progress/lifecycle plus independently observed process/decoder/object-URL/CPU/RSS/heap/GPU release to the relevant platform scope.

areas.task: Define bounded representative actual-data journeys and capture attributable browser/server/native profiles before changing budgets or architecture.
areas.acceptance: Repeatable source/environment/workload records with warm/cold and peak/retained distinctions, adverse samples and maintenance thresholds justified by observations.

areas.task: Verify untested source/cursor/complete-array, multi-source and policy/provider races against the adopted bounded owner. Measure sustained heap/decoded memory and focus/Back under real contention; do not reimplement the superseded client or server-range prototypes.
areas.acceptance: Complete actual composed DTOs/ordering/admission and atomic current-owner publication, source-specific page semantics, bounded measured costs and signed-in acceptance.

areas.task: Collect a fresh actual current-owner profile for one remaining cost or lock cycle, with exact epoch and complete outputs. Prioritize the newly observed Jellyfin finalization deadlock; treat Tasks query/index work as a coordinated read/write decision, not an adopted regression.
areas.acceptance: Winning complete-contract/resource candidate, preserved lock/snapshot/ordering semantics and no hidden regression; source-only preparation is not acceptance.

areas.task: Reconcile the exact ledger gap against existing evidence, then use actual natural inputs or clearly labeled controlled state over actual admin/catalogue identities in a disposable copy. Do not repeat already accepted named cohorts.
areas.acceptance: Complete identities/order/privacy/effects and restoration for the chosen case; distinguish controlled actual state from naturally observed production/provider behavior. No missing format/provider evidence is manufactured.

areas.task: Select finite actual workloads at existing owners. Preserve approved appearance; review any input/mark/image/process budget or retention-policy change before implementation. Comic Lab remains read-only unless separately authorized.
areas.acceptance: Actual render/input/lifecycle and measured CPU/heap/native/GPU behavior with truthful model bounds and no silent truncation or unsupported platform claim.

completionTemplate: Record immutable baseline/current source, actual input provenance, environment/object epoch and all samples/errors.
Compare complete identities/order/counts/privacy/effects, native owner integration and relevant cancellation/retry/concurrency.
Measure repeatable resource work as well as latency; preserve adverse cases and separate CPU/RSS/heap/buffers/WAL/temp scopes.
Adopt at the existing shared root only when evidence supports it; otherwise retain default and record outcome.
Run proportionate focused plus required integration gates; restore/drop owned test state and verify cleanup.
Update docs/performance.md, ledger, exact remaining checklist and source/artifact integrity; do not promote missing acceptance.
